headline: POSTMEN's SUNGTAE drops MV for 'The more you love'
sub: The ballad vocalist returns with a new single
caption:
SUNGTAE of ballad duo POSTMEN has released the music video for his new song 'The more you love' (사랑하면 할수록).

The MV premiered on 1theK's official YouTube channel on Nov 28 at 6 PM KST. Ballad fans, this one's for you. Give it a listen and tell us what you think!
